The '''Old Quarter''' was one half of the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] city [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and consisted of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] and most of the older buildings of the city.

The Old Quarter also contained the crash site of the [[Dowager Queen/Legends|Dowager Queen]].
